prompts.text: The plumbing inspector failed my rough-in because the trap arm on the kitchen sink is too long. What length is allowed before it needs a vent?
I'm replacing my water heater and want to know what size the relief valve discharge pipe has to be and where it can drain.
Can I use PEX for the water supply lines in my basement bathroom, and does the National Plumbing Code limit how far apart the hangers can be?
My new shower drain gurgles whenever the washer drains. I think the vent is undersized or missing, who sets the rules for that?
We need a backwater valve on the sewer line of our older house. Does the permit require it and what pipe slope do we need?
I'm a plumber installing a floor drain in a commercial kitchen. How big should the grease interceptor be and where does it connect?
Do I need a plumbing permit to move a toilet three feet over in my bathroom reno, and what is the minimum drain pipe diameter for it?
The inspector says our backflow preventer on the irrigation line has to be tested annually. What type of device should we install?
We're hosting a craft fair in our community hall. How many people can we legally put inside and where does the occupant load sign have to be posted?
Our restaurant's fire extinguishers haven't been serviced in two years and the fire inspector gave us a notice. How often do they need to be inspected and tagged?
I run a welding shop and we do hot work near stored pallets. Do I need a fire watch after finishing and for how long?
We want to store 200 litres of flammable paint thinner in our garage workshop. Is there a limit and what kind of cabinet do I need?
The fire alarm panel in our existing apartment building keeps showing trouble. Who has to do the yearly inspection and testing, and what records do we keep?
As a property manager I need to write a fire safety plan for our 1990s office building. What does it have to include and how often do we run drills?
Our church wants to put out extra chairs for Christmas Eve and the aisles will be narrower than usual. Can the fire inspector shut us down for that?
We are a propane cylinder exchange at a gas station. How many cylinders can we store outside the building and how far from the door?
We're building a 6-storey office building and need to know what the NECB requires for wall R-values and window performance.
Our mechanical engineer asked for an energy model to show our new warehouse meets the energy code for commercial buildings. What compliance path should we pick?
For a new apartment building of five storeys, what's the maximum lighting power density allowed in the corridors?
I'm replacing the rooftop units on my strip mall. Do the new units have to meet a minimum efficiency and do I need heat recovery?
We're a curtain wall manufacturer and our client's commercial tower needs a U-value that passes the national energy code for buildings. How do we show that?
Our school addition is large and not a house. Does the performance path of the energy code for buildings let us trade off glazing area against a better roof?
The city asked for an energy compliance report with the permit for our new restaurant. What does the commercial energy requirement say about service water heating?
Do we need to add controls so that the HVAC fan schedule and economizer in our new four-storey medical office meet the energy efficiency rules for large buildings?
My electrician says the panel needs a bigger breaker for the new EV charger. What size conductor does the Canadian Electrical Code call for on a 60 amp circuit?
I'm wiring my basement myself. Do I need AFCI breakers on every bedroom circuit and does a homeowner get an electrical permit?
Our solar installer wants to put the inverter next to the main panel. What clearance is required in front of the electrical panel?
The electrical inspector flagged our grounding and bonding on the new service. How many ground rods do we need?
How many outlets are required along the kitchen counter and do they all need GFCI protection?
I run a hot tub on a 50 amp circuit. How far from the tub does the disconnect have to be, and what type of wire is allowed outdoors?
We're upgrading the service on our barn from 100 to 200 amps. Who approves the load calculation and the meter base?
As a contractor I need to know the maximum number of conductors allowed in a one-inch conduit and how the fill is calculated.
A copper drain pipe passes through the one-hour fire separation between my garage and house. How do I show the penetration is firestopped in my variance application?
How many washrooms does our new 80-seat restaurant need, and can we propose fewer fixtures because we do mostly takeout?
The electrical room in our new apartment building opens onto the exit corridor. Does that affect the fire separation rating around the room?
I want to install a gas fireplace on the exterior wall of my new house, only 1.2 m from the property line. Does the limiting distance rule allow it?
For my new house, I want to use a thicker insulation and a heat recovery ventilator that don't fit the prescriptive tables. Can I make an alternative solution for the energy efficiency requirements?
We're designing a new four-storey wood-frame building. Can we use a different sprinkler design than the acceptable solution describes?
Do the emergency lights in the exit stairs of our new office tower need to be on a battery or a generator, and can we propose something different?
The fire department access route to our new warehouse is 5.5 m wide with a tight turning radius. How do we justify it as an alternative?
We have a septic field planned on a sloped lot, but my question is about the house foundation footings nearby. How far must the footings be from the septic tank?
Our new daycare design has a fire alarm system, and I want to know if the sleeping rooms need interconnected smoke alarms or if a different approach can be accepted.
We are building a new mixed-use building with a commercial kitchen below apartments. How should the fire separation and grease exhaust shaft be handled in the design?
I am a manufacturer of a plastic drain pipe. Can I submit a variance showing it meets the flame spread and smoke rules for use in a combustible-construction building?
The mechanical chase in my new building holds plumbing stacks and electrical conduits. What fire rating does the chase wall need?
Our new assembly hall has a calculated occupant load of 450. How many exits and how wide do the exit doors need to be?
A new house I'm building has a hot water tank in a closet beside the bedroom. Does the closet need any special fire rating or ventilation under the building code?
We plan a new high-rise with a standpipe system and fire pump room. How much fire resistance does the pump room need to have?
On a new house build, the wall assembly is thicker with exterior foam and I'm worried about moisture. How do I justify the vapour barrier placement and the insulation values?
My new laneway house has an unusual roof slope. Can I show it meets the roof insulation levels for a house without using the usual tables?
Where must smoke alarms go in the bedrooms of a new two-unit residential building, and do they need to be hard-wired with battery backup?
Our new apartment building has a fire pump and generator room on the ground floor. Can its door open straight to the exit stair?
I'm building a new workshop with a spray booth. What building code separation do I need between it and the rest of the building?
In my new secondary suite, the water heater, furnace and laundry sit in one utility room. Does the room need a fire-rated door, and how do I show an alternative?
We want to use a mass timber floor in a six-storey building, with sprinklers throughout. How do we prove the structure's fire resistance is adequate?
The accessible washroom in our new community centre doesn't fit the clearances. What alternative can we propose for a barrier-free toilet room?
For a new care home, how should the fire compartments and the smoke control for corridors be designed, and what does an inspector expect in the application?
We're adding a rooftop mechanical penthouse with big ductwork to a new building. How do fire dampers in the duct passing through the floor assembly work under the building code?
I'd like to build a house with a wood stove in the living room. What clearances to combustible walls and the hearth does the building code require for a new house?
Our new building has a stair that is also used as an exit and has a standpipe hose connection on each landing. Can the hose cabinet reduce the exit width?
A food-truck pavilion I'm designing is a new building with open sides and a canopy. How do I treat the spatial separation from the neighbouring lot?
For a new small hotel, how many sprinkler heads do we need in the guest rooms, and can the sprinkler coverage in the attic be skipped?
I'm building a new house and want a floor drain in the basement slab and sump pit. How should the slab, the radon rough-in and the drainage layer be built in the foundation?

Our new rental building has a fire separation between suites. We want to run an electrical cable through the wall. Does that need special treatment to maintain the rating, and can we propose a product?
